structured.answer: Joining makes sense: on 30,000 I put 750 a month and the employer 2,250, and after 5 years the page says 136,457 ₪ left in my hands; but there's a scary −64,761 tax at 5 years, so I'd wait the 6 years.

stuck.why: The final 136,457 looks almost the same as the employer's +135,000; for a moment I thought they were the same number
Huge minus scared me; only the small pink 'לפני 6 שנים: מס' hinted it's because it's 5 years, and the page didn't show me the 6-year result
Tab bar sat across the middle of the content covering text

unsure_meaning: striped pink/blue tops on bars (guessed tax)
not_found: Result for pulling out at 6 years (tax-free) shown as a number

findings.what: Default shows withdrawal at 5 years, so a big −64,761 tax dominates the result, though the point is waiting 6 years
Final 136,457 and employer +135,000 look nearly identical, easy to confuse
Striped colored tops on bars not explained near them
Fee only in percent (0.54%), no shekel figure
Sticky tab bar overlaps content mid-screen
Lots of small grey notes I'd never read hold key info (tax rate, cap)
